references.title: Course outline with numbered sections and activity duration
references.question: Q5
references.take: The outline carries a numbered sequence, section titles, activity title, thumbnail, and visible 5-minute duration into the learner-facing course structure.

references.title: Content library cards with type, level, and duration
references.question: Q5
references.take: Library cards expose content type, difficulty level, title, and estimated duration before selection, giving an instructor enough metadata to compare items.

references.title: Recommended learning cards with author and engagement metadata
references.question: Q5
references.take: Recommended tutorial cards combine content type, title, author, description, and lightweight engagement signals so users can judge relevance in the browse view.

references.title: Course catalog with status, type, and tag filters
references.question: Q5
references.take: The course catalog pairs a course card with Status, Course type, and Tags filters, making metadata usable for narrowing a large institutional library.

references.title: Course builder with setup guidance and starter outline
references.question: Q6
references.take: The first course view combines instructional setup banners with an immediately usable outline and clear New lesson/New section actions, reducing the blank-canvas problem.

references.title: Empty lessons state with inline add controls
references.question: Q6
references.take: An empty lessons state still establishes one section and offers inline Add new plus Add section controls, giving a clear first action without invented content.

references.title: Generated course outline with search and add content
references.question: Q6
references.take: Kajabi shows a populated starter outline with a success message, search field, Add content entry points, expandable modules, and draft status controls.

references.title: Curriculum editor with bulk upload and section summary actions
references.question: Q6
references.take: The curriculum editor keeps New lesson, Bulk upload, and Section summary visible at the point where an empty or partial section needs momentum.

references.title: Template browse flow from popular templates to category search
references.question: Q6
references.take: The flow moves from a populated starter view to popular templates, then a category and search list, showing how first-run suggestions can lead directly into a library.

references.title: Add items from a content library with selection and batch add
references.question: Q5
references.take: The six-step flow opens a content library, supports search and multi-selection, then exposes an Add items batch action that returns chosen content to the working document.

references.title: Course lecture list with durations, section grouping, and downloads
references.question: Q5
references.take: The lecture outline keeps section grouping, lesson numbering, media type, remaining duration, and download affordances visible together.

references.title: Mobile curriculum with numbered sections and lesson duration
references.question: Q5
references.take: The mobile curriculum makes sequence explicit with numbered sections while each activity carries a thumbnail, title, and minute estimate.

references.title: Exercise library with category tags and durations
references.question: Q5
references.take: A recommendation list pairs each exercise with a content category and duration range, making short, targeted items easy to scan and compare.

references.title: Program detail flow with lesson count, duration, enrollment, and lesson list
references.question: Q5
references.take: The program detail flow previews a program with total lessons, total hours, enrollment, then drills into a numbered lesson list and individual lesson duration before starting.
